$comment: The public halves of Mailwoman's product signing keys. `license_keys` sign platform license keys (mwl1) and training grants (mwt1); `provenance_keys` sign model provenance manifests (mwp1). The TypeScript verifiers read this file through @mailwoman/license/product/trust, and the Rust verifier embeds it with include_str!. A key moves active -> retired -> revoked and never back; a revoked key is left out of every trust map.
